name: Dorn Hess
bio: Has lost three mechs and walked out of all three. The company doctor has stopped writing it up as remarkable.

personality.label: Dry survivor
personality.description: Rough company, reassuring in a wreck. Has a bleak joke ready before the warning lights settle.

move: Still got legs. Might as well use them.
attack: I have seen prettier targets. Firing.
guard: Fine place to get shot at. Holding.
hold_fire: Giving the guns a rest. They have earned it.
investigate: I will have a look. Try not to spend my pay.
heavy_fire: This is how the last one started. Cover would help.
Still here. Becoming a more impressive statement by the second.
